entry.title: Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Rome 1968 - Discussion - Why are we not aware of the danger of violence?

media:group.media:title: Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Rome 1968 - Discussion - Why are we not aware of the danger of violence?
media:group.media:description:
Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Rome 1968 - Discussion - Why are we not aware of the danger of violence?
Can we uncondition ourselves from the causes of violent spirit?
Can you be aware of conditioning instantly, not gradually through analysis?
Can the mind be free from the mechanism of creating images?
Can you live an experience so completely it does not leave a memory?
Attention means the highest form of sensitivity.
What is relationship?
What does love mean? What is pleasure?
What takes place when there is the observer and the observed?

entry.title: Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Paris 1965 - Public Talk 5 - The root of contradiction is the division...

media:group.media:title: Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Paris 1965 - Public Talk 5 - The root of contradiction is the division...
media:group.media:description:
Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Paris 1965 - Public Talk 5 - The root of contradiction is the division between thinker and thought
We cannot act when there is contradiction within ourselves.
Where there is love, there is also death. The two cannot be separate.
What I am stating has value and meaning only when contradiction totally comes to an end.
Love and death must be for creation to be.
We don’t know how to end sorrow, so we escape through religion or the assertion, ‘Life has no meaning, so just live for today.’
One has to understand life totally.
A mind that is afraid, ambitious, greedy, envious or competitive can never have the energy brought about by action.
Q: What do you mean by self-knowledge?
Q: What is the relation between action and meditation?
